task:
[Автозадача из бэклога] [operator] OKO Сервис — доставка алертов в Telegram + дефолт-конфиг. СБОРКА КОДА фокусно.
1) TelegramReporter в src/oko/live/reporters.py (реализует EventReporter.report): шлёт в Telegram краткий алерт ТОЛЬКО на события с VLM-описанием (человек/животное → описание gemini), формат «👁 ОКО: <описание>». Токен из ~/.bridge-private/secrets.json поле telegramBotToken; chat_id из настройки (env OKO_TG_CHAT или конфиг). По умолчанию ВЫКЛЮЧЕН (включается заданием chat_id). transport инъектируется для офлайн-теста.
2) service.py: дефолт config_path → configs/live-webcam.yaml (НЕ example.yaml), чтобы сервис работал на вебке из коробки. Если OKO_TG_CHAT задан — добавить TelegramReporter в список reporters.
Тесты tests: TelegramReporter с инъекцией transport шлёт корректный запрос ТОЛЬКО на VLM-события (не на object-события); дефолт config = live-webcam.
pytest зелёный. После этого сервис шлёт юзеру алерты при человеке/животном.
goal: To implement a Telegram alert system for the OKO service, specifically for events with VLM descriptions (human/animal detections), and to configure the service to work out-of-the-box with a webcam.
constraints: TelegramReporter must be located at src/oko/live/reporters.py.
Alerts must be sent ONLY for events with VLM descriptions (human/animal detections).
Telegram bot token must be read from ~/.bridge-private/secrets.json, field 'telegramBotToken'.
Telegram chat_id must be read from environment variable OKO_TG_CHAT or service configuration.
TelegramReporter must be OFF by default and enabled only when chat_id is provided.
Transport mechanism for TelegramReporter must be injectable for offline testing.
service.py must use configs/live-webcam.yaml as the default config_path (not example.yaml).
If OKO_TG_CHAT is set, TelegramReporter must be added to the list of reporters in service.py.
The focus of the task is on code implementation ('СБОРКА КОДА фокусно').
known_context: There is an existing EventReporter interface.
Configuration files like configs/live-webcam.yaml and example.yaml exist.
The service does not currently send Telegram alerts for human/animal detections.
output_format: JSON object matching the TaskContract schema.
success_tests: The TelegramReporter class exists in src/oko/live/reporters.py and implements EventReporter.report.
When TelegramReporter.report is called with a VLM-described event, it sends a POST request to the Telegram API.
The Telegram API request body contains the alert in the format '👁 ОКО: <описание>', where <описание> is from the VLM event.
The Telegram API request uses the token from ~/.bridge-private/secrets.json and the chat_id from the configured source.
TelegramReporter.report does NOT send a request when called with a non-VLM event (e.g., an object-only event).
The default config_path in service.py is set to 'configs/live-webcam.yaml'.
If the OKO_TG_CHAT environment variable is set, the TelegramReporter is included in the service's active reporters list.
If the OKO_TG_CHAT environment variable is NOT set, the TelegramReporter is NOT included or is disabled in the service's active reporters list.
When the service is run with OKO_TG_CHAT configured and connected to a webcam, it successfully sends Telegram alerts upon detecting humans or animals.
